content.user_title: Research Amazon products with structured results
content.value_statement: Amazon product research can be slow when listings, prices, ratings, and availability must be reviewed manually. This skill runs a BrowserAct workflow to return structured search-listing data for defined keywords, brands, limits, and languages.
actual_capabilities: Starts a BrowserAct Amazon Product Search workflow with user-supplied keywords.
Applies an optional brand filter to the workflow request.
Accepts a requested product limit and interface language.
Polls the BrowserAct API for task status for up to five minutes.
Uses BROWSERACT_API_KEY as the API credential.
Prints the workflow response when the script receives one.
limitations: Requires a valid BrowserAct account and BROWSERACT_API_KEY.
Results, availability, prices, and sales estimates depend on the external workflow response.
The script currently returns after polling, so its result retrieval step is unreachable.
The skill does not verify Amazon data accuracy, legality, or marketplace terms.

use_cases.title: Compare competing products
use_cases.description: Search a category and brand to review listed prices, ratings, review counts, and Best Seller labels.

use_cases.title: Build a product discovery list
use_cases.description: Collect titles and product URLs for a defined keyword and language.

use_cases.title: Monitor brand availability
use_cases.description: Run targeted searches to review availability and delivery details for a selected brand.

prompt_templates.title: Start a simple search
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for wireless earbuds and return up to 20 results in English.

prompt_templates.title: Filter by brand
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for laptop stands from Samsung. Request 30 results in English.

prompt_templates.title: Run localized research
prompt_templates.prompt: Search Amazon for phone accessories from Sony in Japanese. Request 25 results and summarize available fields.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a monitoring run
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to search Amazon for Apple wireless earbuds, request 50 results, and explain the returned pricing and availability fields.

output_examples.input: Search for wireless earbuds from Sony with a limit of 20.
output: Task status updates while BrowserAct processes the request.
A product listing response with titles, URLs, prices, ratings, review counts, and availability when provided by the API.

output_examples.input: Search for laptop stands in German.
output: A response that may include listing details, delivery information, and Best Seller labels.

best_practices: Confirm the search keywords, brand, limit, and language before starting the workflow.
Store BROWSERACT_API_KEY in an environment variable and never include it in prompts or reports.
Review external data for accuracy and compliance before using it in decisions.
anti_patterns: Do not request or paste API keys into chat messages.
Do not treat estimated sales or listing details as verified business facts.
Do not use large result limits without considering BrowserAct costs and marketplace terms.

faq.question: What credential does this skill need?
faq.answer: It requires BROWSERACT_API_KEY for the BrowserAct API.

faq.question: Does it search Amazon directly from my computer?
faq.answer: No. The script sends a workflow request to BrowserAct, which performs the external task.

faq.question: What filters are available?
faq.answer: You can provide keywords, an optional brand, a product limit, and a language.

faq.question: Which languages are documented?
faq.answer: The skill documents English, German, French, Italian, Spanish, Japanese, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese.

faq.question: How long does a task run?
faq.answer: The script polls for up to five minutes and reports status updates every ten seconds.

faq.question: Are prices and sales estimates guaranteed?
faq.answer: No. Values come from the external workflow and may be missing, delayed, estimated, or inaccurate.
